Ambiguity: both stored texts begin with the cue opening ' line!\n\nOkay' (F's rln3 text includes the prefill; K's text includes the 3-token opening), so the 3000/8000-char windows include ~12 identical chars. Files: runs/theory-tests/duel-r4-m01/d4fa_answers.jsonl (modal volume iterate-runs abaybektursun-1114-151718-d4fa/answers.jsonl, 500 run_cell rows, base cue T0.6 top-p 1.0) and runs/theory-tests/duel-r4-m01/s2800_P_math500.jsonl (s3 .../r3/s2800-01/out/P_math500.jsonl, 500 rln3_gen rows, all sample 0). Filters as written: len(text) >= 6000 chars (text includes the cue opening), keep loop_A false, keep loop_A true only if onset_A_char is present and >= 7000; join by problem_index to the RL sample-0 row; d = RL n_generated as stored (cap hits not altered). AUROC = Mann-Whitney over all positive/negative pairs, d_pos > d_neg scores 1, ties 0.5 (higher d predicts loop). Kept rows, positives, negatives and RL cap hits are printed. Alt reading: d = RL n_new instead of n_generated (in the one RL row opened n_generated = n_new + 1 even with empty prefill, so alt should equal main unless the offset varies; it is a check rather than a substantive alternative — the recipe is otherwise unambiguous). If there are no positives or no negatives the script reports not_computable (AUROC undefined); the recipe does not say that case is refuted. RL cap hits stored at about 16,384 tie with each other and count 0.5 in pairs among themselves.

Files: same as k=2 (d4fa answers.jsonl and s2800 P_math500.jsonl in runs/theory-tests/duel-r4-m01/). Same row filters and join as k=2. s = len(zlib.compress(text[:6000].encode('utf-8'), 9)) / len(text[:6000].encode('utf-8')) on the stored text (which begins with the cue opening); d = RL n_generated. q1,q2,q3 = numpy.percentile(d over kept rows, [25,50,75]) linear; strata d<=q1, q1<d<=q2, q2<d<=q3, d>q3 (ties in d, e.g. RL cap hits, all land in the same stratum, so strata can be unequal in size). Main statistic: pooled within-stratum pairs, pair scores 1 if s_pos < s_neg, 0.5 if equal; total score / total pairs; per-stratum rows, positives, negatives, pairs and AUC printed. Alt reading: unweighted mean of the per-stratum AUROCs over strata with both classes. If no within-stratum pairs exist the script reports not_computable.
